titleEn: SpaceX Technical Talk: AI Satellites at Scale
summaryEn: Elon Musk and the SpaceX team give a technical talk on manufacturing, launching and operating AI satellites at scale — the orbital compute backbone of the merged SpaceX AI, from Starship cadence to the AI-1 satellite and gigawatt-class power in space.
